ModMetaData.name: Over Haulers - Weight Capacity Redefined
ModMetaData.author: Jay "iClustaFlux" Rogers
ModMetaData.description:
Dynamically overhauls Caravan Mass Capacity (max total inventory weight)
No more arbitrary limits! Inventory weight capacity scales with: - Pawn anatomy and Systemic health - Prosthetic replacements and implants
Compatibility: - RimWorld Core and expansions - (CE) Combat Extended - (VEF) Vanilla Expanded Framework
Also includes optional experimental features to detect and adopt other third-party mods.
No hard dependencies beyond Harmony.
100% Safe to add or remove mid-save.
